card.name: Last piece of brand drug names
card.fires_on: The final piece of a newly coined brand drug name split into several parts, such as XTAMPZA, SILIQ, TALVEY or RUKOBIA. It also fires on '.com' ending a site name.

modes.label: Brand name ending
modes.description: Closing piece of an unfamiliar capitalized brand drug name in label text.

modes.label: Website name ending

card.writes: It nudges output toward naming-style continuations and away from words about commercial or corporate things.
card.plain: It marks the last bit of a made-up brand drug name, right where the name is complete.
